title: Coffee Roastery Simulation
summary: Modeled operations at Black Knight Coffee Roastery to study bottlenecks and throughput.
challenge: Understand how roasting and packaging resources affect flow time.
approach: Studied a system with three roasters and two packaging resources; investigated packaging as a bottleneck.
outcome: Project analysis reported a reduction in time in system from 12 hours to 2 hours under an improved scenario.
learned: Improving the constraint can matter more than increasing capacity everywhere.
